```{r, warning=F}


library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

source("../../00-constants.R")






# 12 - Figure 2


# Import Figure 2A
p2A <- readRDS(
  file.path(gene_results_dir, "figure2A.rds")
)

# Import Figure 2B
p2B <- readRDS(
  file.path(prot_results_dir, "figure2B.rds")
)

# Import Figure 2C
p2C <- readRDS(
  file.path(gene_results_dir, "figure2C.rds")
)



# Figure 2 assembly

p2A <- p2A +
  theme(
    aspect.ratio=1,
    plot.margin=margin(
      t=10,
      r=10,
      b=40,
      l=10
    )
  )

p2B <- p2B +
  theme(
    aspect.ratio=1,
    plot.caption=element_text(
      margin=margin(t=-15)
    ),
    plot.margin=margin(
      t=300,
      r=15,
      b=10,
      l=10
    )
  )

figure_2 <- (
  p2A /
  p2B
) | p2C


figure_2 <- figure_2 +
  plot_layout(
    widths=c(8, 8),
    heights=c(6.2, 6.8)
  ) &
  theme(
    plot.margin=margin(
      t=10,
      r=20,
      b=10,
      l=20
    )
  )


figure_2 <- figure_2 +
  plot_annotation(
    tag_levels="A",
    theme=theme(
      plot.tag=element_text(
        size=12,
        family="Arial",
        face="plain"
      )
    )
  )


# Export Figure 2

ggsave(
  file.path(plots_dir, "Figure_2.pdf"),
  figure_2,
  width=16,
  height=13,
  device=cairo_pdf,
  bg="white"
)






# 12 - Figure 3


# Import Figure 3 plot objects

p3A <- readRDS(
  file.path(gene_results_dir, "figure3A.rds")
)

p3B <- readRDS(
  file.path(gene_results_dir, "figure3B.rds")
)

p3C <- readRDS(
  file.path(gene_results_dir, "figure3C.rds")
)

p3D <- readRDS(
  file.path(gene_results_dir, "figure3D.rds")
)

p3E <- readRDS(
  file.path(gene_results_dir, "figure3E.rds")
)

p3F <- readRDS(
  file.path(gene_results_dir, "figure3F.rds")
)


# Combine Figure 3 panels

p3A <- p3A +
  theme(
    aspect.ratio=1
  )

p3B <- p3B +
  theme(
    aspect.ratio=1
  )

p3C <- p3C +
  theme(
    aspect.ratio=1
  )

p3D <- p3D +
  theme(
    aspect.ratio=1
  )

p3E <- p3E +
  theme(
    aspect.ratio=1
  )

p3F <- p3F +
  theme(
    aspect.ratio=1
  )


figure_3 <- (
  p3A | p3B
) /
(
  p3C | p3D
) /
(
  p3E | p3F
)


figure_3 <- figure_3 +
  plot_layout(
    widths=c(1, 1),
    heights=c(1, 1, 1)
  ) &
  theme(
    plot.margin=ggplot2::margin(
      t=15,
      r=35,
      b=15,
      l=25
    )
  )


figure_3 <- figure_3 +
  plot_annotation(
    tag_levels="A",
    theme=theme(
      plot.tag=element_text(
        size=12,
        family="Arial",
        face="plain"
      )
    )
  )


# Export Figure 3

ggsave(
  file.path(plots_dir, "Figure_3.pdf"),
  figure_3,
  width=14,
  height=21,
  device=cairo_pdf,
  bg="white"
)







# 12 - Figure 4


p4A <- readRDS(
  file.path(gene_results_dir, "figure4A.rds")
)

p4B <- readRDS(
  file.path(gene_results_dir, "figure4B.rds")
)

p4C <- readRDS(
  file.path(prot_results_dir, "figure4C.rds")
)

p4D <- readRDS(
  file.path(gene_results_dir, "figure4D.rds")
)

p4E <- readRDS(
  file.path(gene_results_dir, "figure4E.rds")
)

p4F <- readRDS(
  file.path(gene_results_dir,"figure4F.rds")
)


# Make Figure 4

figure_4 <- (
  wrap_elements(full = p4A) | p4B | p4C
) /
(
  p4D | p4E | p4F
)

figure_4 <- figure_4 +
  plot_layout(
    widths = c(1, 1, 1),
    heights = c(1, 1)
  ) &
  theme(
    plot.margin = margin(
      t = 15,
      r = 35,
      b = 15,
      l = 35
    )
  )


# Add panel labels

figure_4 <- figure_4 +
  plot_annotation(
    tag_levels = "A",
    theme = theme(
      plot.tag = element_text(
        size = 12,
        family = "Arial",
        face = "plain"
      ),
      plot.tag.position = c(0, 1)
    )
  )


# Export Figure 4

ggsave(
  file.path(plots_dir, "Figure_4.pdf"),
  figure_4,
  width = 21,
  height = 14,
  device = cairo_pdf,
  bg = "white"
)
```
